name: fillet-spans-seam-and-rim
why: The one wrong part ParCAD let a model ship in 288 head-to-head trials (research_notes/hands-on/h2h, retainer-P-haiku-2): { curve: "circle", adjacentTo: { faceNormal: "+z" } } was meant for the concave seam where the cylinder meets the block's top and also took the cylinder's convex top rim, and the reply said only edges: 2. The treatment must name both kinds and the dihedral that keeps one. The part itself is the wrong one on purpose: rounding the rim takes about 158 mm3 more than the seam's blend adds, so the volume sits below the plain union's.

treatments.mixed_corners: 1 concave, 1 convex: this selector caught inside and outside corners together. Unless both were meant, add dihedral: "concave" to treat only the inside seams, or dihedral: "convex" for only the outside edges
